proposal.name: rules-v8 (provisional)
proposal.changes_only: input choice of an Energy Trans candidate already chosen by the existing ranks
kept: candidate ranks (attack 4, retreat / powers 5, end_turn 6, demoted 7)
order: 1. remove the rules-v6 deferred moves (existing restriction)
2. tier 1: moves after which an unmet goal (active's attack or retreat) is met
3. tier 2: moves that reduce the deficit of a goal confirmed reachable
4. tier 3: otherwise (or not evaluable) the existing stage-wise uniform choice
proposal.draw: within the chosen tier, the existing stage-wise uniform choice restricted to that tier (build_choices restriction = moves outside the tier); no new attack / retreat priority
implementation_reuse: actions.build_choices restriction (3-stage) for the tier set
unit assignment identical to kyuura_engine.cards.can_pay_with_units (re-implemented in the tool; the tool does not import the engine)
retreat payment: same subset-sum rule as actions._choose_by_units (total_units range, cards not split)

progress_calculation.units: own active energy_units from the view (one entry per unit, colours already include colour-changing effects); a moved basic energy card gives the units of its type
progress_calculation.attack: can_pay_with_units(cost, units): colour symbols assigned one unit each (bipartite), colourless paid by the rest; colourless units never pay colour symbols
progress_calculation.retreat: some subset of the active's cards has unit sum within total_units [min, max] (2-unit cards are not split)
progress_calculation.deficit: smallest number of movable cards (own energy cards with an Energy Trans move to the active in the unrestricted move set of the current inputs) whose addition meets the goal; none -> unreachable
progress_calculation.tier2_condition: deficit after the move < deficit before, and the goal is reachable
progress_calculation.cost_met_vs_operable: cost met is computed; operable is not assumed: attack goals only when the active is not asleep / paralysed and the attack has no problem / payer / provider in the view; retreat goals only when the retreat candidate is presented now; actual operability is confirmed by the next candidates

observation_and_inputs: own active energy units, special conditions, markers, persistent effects, trainers (view)
attacks the active has now: printed card id and index (view)
Energy Trans move set and energy card ids (inputs)
retreat total_units with modifiers only in retreat inputs (fetched in the same view, or the rules-v7 failure record at the same payment key)
attack printed cost only in the attack candidate's inputs, i.e. only after the attack is declarable
not_available: printed attack cost of an attack not yet declarable (not in view / candidates / ET inputs)
retreat cost modifiers without retreat inputs (printed cost alone is not the effective cost)
per-card units of special energy already attached (view units are flattened)
colour readings when energy_units_determined is false (CE1 / CE2)
attack prohibitions not visible in the view (engine check_use_attack)

options: read-only fetch of retreat inputs in the same view when Energy Trans is chosen (runner change, extra request)
use only the rules-v7 failure record / inputs already fetched in the episode
API: printed cost in the view's attack entries (engine / contract change, separate unit)
tool-side printed card data (public data, but outside the API responses the policies use today)
stage-wise uniform restricted to the tier (reuses restriction)
uniform over tier moves (new tuple draw)

decisions_before_implementation.what: goal already met (retreat payable, attack unreachable)
decisions_before_implementation.note: tier 3 fallback may move energy off the active (9056 n193-type); protecting met goals is a separate decision
evaluate only with retreat inputs (per-card units) or fall back

replay.note: re-scored saved attempts only (same view and fetched inputs); later trajectories are not predicted; costs from card data as the verifier (see information)

boards.board: 9056 n124 type: active Venusaur 0 energy (retreat 2, Solarbeam GGGG); bench Bulbasaur 3 grass, Parasect 3, Tangela 1, Bulbasaur, Tangela
boards.expected: same view and inputs: 35 moves -> tier 2 set of 7 (moves onto the active); retreat / attack ranks unchanged
boards.pass: chosen move in the tier set; unpayable retreat re-selection 0; record moves until retreat cost met and until attack

boards.board: active Venusaur 0; bench Ivysaur 1 grass, Bulbasaur 1 grass
boards.expected: move 1 tier 2, move 2 tier 1 (retreat); attack unreachable
boards.pass: retreat payable after 2 ET in every seed; retreat accepted in >= 1 seed (tie with ET unchanged); no re-selection of unpayable retreat

boards.board: active Tangela 0 (Bind G+C); bench Venusaur 2 grass
boards.expected: tier 2 then tier 1; attack presented and chosen (rank 4)
boards.pass: attack accepted in every seed after exactly 2 ET

boards.expected: tiers 2, 2, 2, 1; retreat becomes payable after 2 (tie with ET unchanged)
boards.pass: Solarbeam reachable with 4 ET in >= 1 seed; no seed blocked by the proposal (no count limit); a cap below 4 would fail

boards.board: active Venusaur 0; bench Bulbasaur 1 grass, Tangela (grass 1 < retreat 2; no attack payable)
boards.expected: both goals unreachable -> tier 3 (existing choice); no fewer operations expected
boards.pass: unreachable judged from the move set and costs; choices identical to rules-v7 for the same RNG state

boards.board: active needing a colour ET cannot supply (e.g. fighting + colourless) with grass on the bench
boards.expected: grass may pay colourless only; colour symbol unreachable -> not tier 2
boards.pass: no move scored as progress for that attack

boards.board: active with a Double Colorless Energy (2 units) and retreat 3
boards.expected: evaluated only with retreat inputs (per-card units); else fallback
boards.pass: no tier from flattened units alone

boards.board: colour readings undetermined (CE1 / CE2) or view missing

boards.expected: attack / retreat goals not operable -> fallback

comparison_plan_not_run.setup: 0.198.0, TR8@1, C2 fixed decks v2, deep; rules-v7 vs rules-v8 only; same seats / limits / observation / prestop as the saved plans
measures: ET until a goal cost is first met (per goal)
rules: compare only the first divergence point as the same state; later boards are separate paths

e5_remaining: unreachable states are identifiable when costs are known, but the proposal only ranks inputs; ET still outranks end_turn, so operation counts are not expected to fall. Demoting the whole power candidate or a count limit remains a separate decision (E4 is the control for any limit)

failures.what: first replay judged reachability on the move set after the rules-v6 exclusion (9045: 22 false unreachable); fixed to the unrestricted set and re-run
